**Transaction Fraud Detection Analysis**

This project cleans transaction data, prepares features for machine learning, and compares Logistic Regression and Random Forest models for fraud prediction.

**1. Setup and Load Data**
```{r,echo=TRUE,results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

setwd("C:/Users/lemy1/OneDrive/Datalearn/transaction/markdown")

list.files()
packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "tidymodels",
  "readxl",
  "dplyr",
  "rsample",
  "ranger",
  "lubridate"
)

install.packages(
  packages,
  repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
)

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(rsample)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)

customers <- read_excel("customers.xltx")
merchants <- read_excel("merchants.xltx")
transactions_train <- read_excel("transactions_train.xltx")
transactions_eval <- read_excel("transactions_eval.xltx")
```

**2. Data Cleaning and Validation**

**2.1 Check Missing Values**

```{r,echo=TRUE}
check_missing <- function(data, dataset_name) {
  
  data.frame(
    Dataset = dataset_name,
    Column = names(data),
    Total_Rows = nrow(data),
    Missing_Count = colSums(is.na(data)),
    Missing_Percent = round(
      colSums(is.na(data)) / nrow(data) * 100,
      2
    )
  )
}
missing_customers <- check_missing(
  customers,
  "Customers"
)

missing_merchants <- check_missing(
  merchants,
  "Merchants"
)

missing_train <- check_missing(
  transactions_train,
  "Transactions Train"
)

missing_eval <- check_missing(
  transactions_eval,
  "Transactions Evaluation"
)

missing_summary <- bind_rows(
  missing_customers,
  missing_merchants,
  missing_train,
  missing_eval
)

missing_summary
```
**2.2 Remove Exact Duplicate Rows**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
valid_customers <- distinct(customers)

valid_merchants <- distinct(merchants)

transactions_train_clean <- distinct(
  transactions_train
)

transactions_eval_clean <- distinct(
  transactions_eval
)

sum(duplicated(transactions_train_clean))
```

**2.3 Check Duplicate Transaction IDs**

```{r,echo=TRUE}
sum(
  duplicated(
    transactions_train_clean$transaction_id
  )
)

duplicate_transactions_id <- transactions_train_clean %>%
  add_count(transaction_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

duplicate_transactions_id
```

**2.4 Check Transaction and Fraud Distribution**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
n_distinct(
  transactions_train_clean$transaction_id
)

table(
  transactions_train_clean$is_fraud
)

prop.table(
  table(transactions_train_clean$is_fraud)
) * 100
```

**2.5 Validate Duplicate Transactions**

This section checks whether duplicate transaction IDs contain valid customer and merchant IDs.

```{r,echo=TRUE}
duplicate_check <- duplicate_transactions_id %>%
  left_join(
    valid_customers %>%
      mutate(customer_exists = TRUE),
    by = "customer_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    valid_merchants %>%
      mutate(merchant_exists = TRUE),
    by = "merchant_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    customer_exists = ifelse(
      is.na(customer_exists),
      FALSE,
      TRUE
    ),
    merchant_exists = ifelse(
      is.na(merchant_exists),
      FALSE,
      TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    customer_id,
    merchant_id,
    customer_exists,
    merchant_exists,
    transaction_amount,
    is_fraud
  )

duplicate_check
```

**2.6 Summarize Duplicate Transactions**

```{r,echo=TRUE}
duplicate_check %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    valid_rows = sum(
      customer_exists & merchant_exists
    ),
    orphan_rows = sum(
      !customer_exists | !merchant_exists
    ),
    fraud_labels = n_distinct(is_fraud),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  count(
    valid_rows,
    orphan_rows,
    fraud_labels
  )
```
**2.7 Check for Conflicting Fraud Labels**

```{r,echo=TRUE}
duplicate_check %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  summarise(
    fraud_labels = paste(
      unique(is_fraud),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    grepl(",", fraud_labels)
  )
```

**2.8 Keep Valid Transactions**

Only transactions with valid customer and merchant IDs are retained.
```{r,echo=TRUE}
transactions_train_clean <- transactions_train_clean %>%
  semi_join(
    valid_customers,
    by = "customer_id"
  ) %>%
  semi_join(
    valid_merchants,
    by = "merchant_id"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    transaction_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

sum(
  duplicated(
    transactions_train_clean$transaction_id
  )
)
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
missing_train_clean <- data.frame(
  column = names(
    transactions_train_clean
  ),
  missing_count = colSums(
    is.na(transactions_train_clean)
  ),
  missing_percent = round(
    colMeans(
      is.na(transactions_train_clean)
    ) * 100,

)

missing_train_clean
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
fraud_status_summary <- transactions_train_clean %>%
  group_by(is_fraud) %>%
  summarise(
    total_transactions = n(),
    negative_amount = sum(
      transaction_amount < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    negative_distance = sum(
      distance_from_home_miles < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    average_amount = mean(

      na.rm = TRUE

    average_distance = mean(
      distance_from_home_miles,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fraud_status_summary
```

**3.7 Handle Negative Values**

Negative values are flagged and replaced with missing values.
```{r,echo=TRUE}
transactions_train_clean <- transactions_train_clean %>%
  mutate(
    amount_negative_flag = if_else(
      !is.na(transaction_amount) &
        transaction_amount < 0,
      1L,
      0L
    ),

    distance_negative_flag = if_else(
      !is.na(distance_from_home_miles) &
        distance_from_home_miles < 0,
      1L,
      0L
    ),

    transaction_amount = if_else(
      transaction_amount < 0,
      NA_real_,
      transaction_amount
    ),

    distance_from_home_miles = if_else(
      distance_from_home_miles < 0,
      NA_real_,
      distance_from_home_miles
    )
  )

transactions_train_clean %>%
  summarise(
    negative_amount_left = sum(
      transaction_amount < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    negative_distance_left = sum(
      distance_from_home_miles < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    amount_flags = sum(
      amount_negative_flag
    ),
    distance_flags = sum(
      distance_negative_flag
    )
  )
```
**4. Merge Data Tables**

**4.1 Prepare Customer and Merchant Data**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
customers_join <- valid_customers %>%
  distinct(
    customer_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

merchants_join <- valid_merchants %>%
  distinct(
    merchant_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )
```
**4.2 Join Transaction, Customer, and Merchant Data**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
train_data <- transactions_train_clean %>%
  left_join(
    customers_join,
    by = "customer_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    merchants_join,
    by = "merchant_id"
  )

head(train_data)
```
**4.3 Check Missing Values After Joining**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
missing_joined <- data.frame(
  column = names(train_data),
  missing_count = colSums(
    is.na(train_data)
  ),
  missing_percent = round(
    colMeans(
      is.na(train_data)
    ) * 100,
    2
  )
)

missing_joined
```
**5. Feature Engineering and Data Preparation**

**5.1 Select Model Features**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
model_data <- train_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    is_fraud,
    transaction_amount,
    transaction_datetime,
    is_online,
    card_present,
    distance_from_home_miles,
    hours_since_last_txn,
    ratio_to_median_purchase,
    num_txns_last_24h,
    amount_negative_flag,
    distance_negative_flag,
    account_age_days,
    merchant_category,
    is_international
  )

head(model_data)
```

**5.2 Normalize Categorical Variables**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(
    is_online = str_to_lower(
      trimws(is_online)
    ),
    card_present = str_to_lower(
      trimws(card_present)
    ),
    is_international = str_to_lower(
      trimws(is_international)
    ),
    merchant_category = str_to_lower(
      trimws(merchant_category)
    )
  )

head(model_data)
```
**5.3 Create Time-Based Features**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_hour = hour(
      transaction_datetime
    ),
    transaction_day = wday(
      transaction_datetime,
      label = TRUE
    ),
    transaction_month = month(
      transaction_datetime
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -transaction_datetime
  )

head(model_data)
```
**5.4 Split Data into Training and Testing Sets**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
set.seed(123)

data_split <- initial_split(
  model_data,
  prop = 0.80,
  strata = is_fraud
)

train_set <- training(
  data_split
)

test_set <- testing(
  data_split
)

prop.table(
  table(train_set$is_fraud)
)

prop.table(
  table(test_set$is_fraud)
)
```
**6. Logistic Regression Model**

**6.1 Prepare Data for Machine Learning**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
train_set <- train_set %>%
  mutate(
    is_fraud = factor(
      if_else(
        is_fraud == 1,
        "fraud",
        "legitimate"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "legitimate",
        "fraud"
      )
    )
  )

test_set <- test_set %>%
  mutate(
    is_fraud = factor(
      if_else(
        is_fraud == 1,
        "fraud",
        "legitimate"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "legitimate",
        "fraud"
      )
    )
  )
```
**6.2 Create a Data Recipe**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
fraud_recipe <- recipe(
  is_fraud ~ .,
  data = train_set
) %>%
  update_role(
    transaction_id,
    new_role = "id"
  ) %>%
  step_string2factor(
    all_nominal_predictors()
  ) %>%
  step_unknown(
    all_nominal_predictors()
  ) %>%
  step_novel(
    all_nominal_predictors()
  ) %>%
  step_impute_median(
    all_numeric_predictors()
  ) %>%
  step_dummy(
    all_nominal_predictors()
  ) %>%
  step_rm(
    transaction_id
  ) %>%
  step_zv(
    all_predictors()
  ) %>%
  step_normalize(
    all_numeric_predictors()
  )
```
**6.3 Build the Logistic Regression Model**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
log_model <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

log_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(fraud_recipe) %>%
  add_model(log_model)

set.seed(123)

log_fit <- fit(
  log_workflow,
  data = train_set
)
```
**6.4 Predict Fraud**

```{r,echo=TRUE}
fraud_prob <- predict(
  log_fit,
  new_data = test_set,
  type = "prob"
)

fraud_class <- predict(
  log_fit,
  new_data = test_set,
  type = "class"
)

results <- bind_cols(
  test_set %>%
    select(is_fraud),
  fraud_prob,
  fraud_class
)

head(results)
```
**6.5 Evaluate Logistic Regression**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
pr_auc(
  results,
  truth = is_fraud,
  .pred_fraud,
  event_level = "second"
)

roc_auc(
  results,
  truth = is_fraud,
  .pred_fraud,
  event_level = "second"
)

conf_mat(
  results,
  truth = is_fraud,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

metric_set(
  precision,
  recall,
  f_meas
)(
  results,
  truth = is_fraud,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  event_level = "second"
)
```
**6.6 Test Different Classification Thresholds**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
threshold_results <- map_dfr(
  c(
    0.05,
    0.10,
    0.15,
    0.20,
    0.30,
    0.50
  ),
  function(threshold) {

    pred <- factor(
      if_else(
        results$.pred_fraud >= threshold,
        "fraud",
        "legitimate"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "legitimate",
        "fraud"
      )
    )

    tibble(
      threshold = threshold,

      precision = precision_vec(
        results$is_fraud,
        pred,
        event_level = "second"
      ),

      recall = recall_vec(
        results$is_fraud,
        pred,
        event_level = "second"
      ),

      f1 = f_meas_vec(
        results$is_fraud,
        pred,
        event_level = "second"
      )
    )
  }
)

threshold_results
```
**7. Random Forest Model**

**7.1 Build the Random Forest Model**

```{r,echo=TRUE}
rf_model <- rand_forest(
  mtry = 5,
  trees = 50,
  min_n = 10
) %>%
  set_engine(
    "ranger",
    probability = TRUE,
    class.weights = c(1, 10),
    num.threads = 2
  ) %>%
  set_mode("classification")

rf_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(fraud_recipe) %>%
  add_model(rf_model)

set.seed(123)

rf_fit <- fit(
  rf_workflow,
  data = train_set
)
```
**7.2 Evaluate the Random Forest Model**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
rf_prob <- predict(
  rf_fit,
  new_data = test_set,
  type = "prob"
)

rf_results <- bind_cols(
  test_set %>%
    select(is_fraud),
  rf_prob
)

pr_auc(
  rf_results,
  truth = is_fraud,
  .pred_fraud,
  event_level = "second"
)

roc_auc(
  rf_results,
  truth = is_fraud,
  .pred_fraud,
  event_level = "second"
)
```
**7.3 Find an Appropriate Random Forest Threshold**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
rf_threshold_results <- map_dfr(
  c(
    0.05,
    0.10,
    0.15,
    0.20,
    0.30,
    0.50
  ),
  function(threshold) {

    pred <- factor(
      if_else(
        rf_results$.pred_fraud >= threshold,
        "fraud",
        "legitimate"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "legitimate",
        "fraud"
      )
    )

    tibble(
      threshold = threshold,

      precision = precision_vec(
        rf_results$is_fraud,
        pred,
        event_level = "second"
      ),

      recall = recall_vec(
        rf_results$is_fraud,
        pred,
        event_level = "second"
      ),

      f1 = f_meas_vec(
        rf_results$is_fraud,
        pred,
        event_level = "second"
      )
    )
  }
)

rf_threshold_results
```
**8. Prepare Evaluation Data**

**8.1 Keep Valid Evaluation Transactions**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
eval_valid <- transactions_eval_clean %>%
  semi_join(
    customers_join,
    by = "customer_id"
  ) %>%
  semi_join(
    merchants_join,
    by = "merchant_id"
  )

transactions_eval_clean <- eval_valid %>%
  distinct(
    transaction_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )
```
**8.2 Join Evaluation Data**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
eval_data <- transactions_eval_clean %>%
  left_join(
    customers_join,
    by = "customer_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    merchants_join,
    by = "merchant_id"
  )

head(eval_data)
```
**9. Prepare Evaluation Features**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
eval_model_data <- eval_data %>%
  mutate(
    amount_negative_flag = if_else(
      !is.na(transaction_amount) &
        transaction_amount < 0,
      1L,
      0L
    ),

    distance_negative_flag = if_else(
      !is.na(distance_from_home_miles) &
        distance_from_home_miles < 0,
      1L,
      0L
    ),

    transaction_amount = if_else(
      transaction_amount < 0,
      NA_real_,
      transaction_amount
    ),

    distance_from_home_miles = if_else(
      distance_from_home_miles < 0,
      NA_real_,
      distance_from_home_miles
    ),

    is_online = str_to_lower(
      trimws(is_online)
    ),

    card_present = str_to_lower(
      trimws(card_present)
    ),

    is_international = str_to_lower(
      trimws(is_international)
    ),

    merchant_category = str_to_lower(
      trimws(merchant_category)
    ),

    transaction_hour = hour(
      transaction_datetime
    ),

    transaction_day = wday(
      transaction_datetime,
      label = TRUE
    ),

    transaction_month = month(
      transaction_datetime
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    transaction_amount,
    is_online,
    card_present,
    distance_from_home_miles,
    hours_since_last_txn,
    ratio_to_median_purchase,
    num_txns_last_24h,
    amount_negative_flag,
    distance_negative_flag,
    account_age_days,
    merchant_category,
    is_international,
    transaction_hour,
    transaction_day,
    transaction_month
  )

head(eval_model_data)
```
**10. Preserve Unique Evaluation Transactions**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
eval_source <- transactions_eval %>%
  mutate(
    customer_valid =
      customer_id %in%
      customers_join$customer_id,

    merchant_valid =
      merchant_id %in%
      merchants_join$merchant_id,

    both_valid =
      customer_valid &
      merchant_valid
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    transaction_id,
    desc(both_valid),
    desc(customer_valid),
    desc(merchant_valid)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    transaction_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  select(
    -customer_valid,
    -merchant_valid,
    -both_valid
  )

eval_source
```
**11. Predict Fraud Probabilities**

The Random Forest model is used to predict the probability that each evaluation transaction is fraudulent.
```{r,echo=TRUE}
rf_predictions <- predict(
  rf_fit,
  new_data = eval_model_data,
  type = "prob"
)

head(rf_predictions)
dim(rf_predictions)
```
**12. Create Submission File**
```{r,echo=TRUE}
submission <- tibble(
  transaction_id =
    eval_model_data$transaction_id,

  fraud_probability =
    rf_predictions$.pred_fraud
)

head(submission)
```
```{r,echo=TRUE}
write.csv(
  submission,
  "fraud_submission.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
**Conclusion**

This project applies a complete fraud detection workflow:

Load and validate transaction data.

Remove duplicate and invalid transactions.

Identify and handle unusual values.

Merge transaction, customer, and merchant data.

Create features for machine learning.

Build and evaluate a Logistic Regression model.

Build and evaluate a Random Forest model.

Select appropriate classification thresholds.

Predict fraud probabilities for evaluation transactions.

The final output is the submission dataset, which contains each transaction ID and its predicted fraud probability
